shorts.title: An 11-Year-Old Found a Sea Reptile as Big as a Blue Whale
shorts.outro: It swam straight over Doug's cage and ignored him. Two stops later, a sperm whale with a three-meter skull did not. Linked below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT DID THE GIANT SPERM WHALE DO?
shorts.description: A girl on a Somerset beach found the jaw of a 25-meter fish lizard that ignored Doug's cage, and the full episode shows what a giant sperm whale did to him two stops later.

shorts.title: These Orcas Eat Sharks and Wear Their Teeth to the Gums
shorts.outro: Then Doug got into a cage next to a shark, right in front of them, holding a toothbrush. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT DID DOUG DO WITH THE TOOTHBRUSH?
shorts.description: Offshore orcas eat so much sandpaper-skinned shark that their teeth wear flat, and the full episode reveals what Doug did next to them with a toothbrush.

shorts.hook: HMS Challenger hauled up megalodon teeth from the Pacific.
shorts.title: The Teeth That Made Megalodon Seem Modern Were Ancient
shorts.outro: So it is not down there. Doug went to see the last megalodon instead, three point six million years ago. It is linked below.
shorts.end_card: HOW DID THE LAST MEGALODON VANISH?
shorts.description: Two deep-sea teeth once made megalodon look only 11,000 years old until a re-check proved otherwise, and the full episode follows Doug to the last megalodon to find out how it vanished.
